note: All 197 bundles read (mostly Middle Irish pivots from CELT, many Auraicept/ogam grammar passages, with late Greek prose and Old Norse prose partners). No claim I would defend. Leads tested and rejected: BC-15b37 OIr bodar ~ Ved. badhirá with *ḱlew- 'hear' (the Irish is a stock curse triad 'dall/bodar/marb cach oen...' attested 6+ times; RV 4.23.8 and 9.73.6 use badhirá in different figures; blind/deaf pairing generic); BC-70536 fer + caur ~ RV 8.2.25 vīrā́ya śū́rāya (no fer+caur collocation in the Irish line); BC-38153 cattle/oxen/horses/gold/silver catalogue ~ Greek wealth lists (generic, likely biblical); BC-45825 OIr bráthair a máthar ~ ON móðurbróðir (productive descriptive kin term); fír flatha bundles (BC-2b565, BC-38ab3, BC-4bfea, BC-54a65, BC-92018, BC-9f22c) have no partner carrying the ruler's-truth topos (the Homeric Od. 19.109-114 parallel is not in the slab).
